ballot_status.unverified: Scheduled contest; final ballot appearance unverified

election_type.special: Special election to fill a vacancy or unexpired term

ocd_id_status.verified: Exact identifier verified against a registry or API

limitations: Unresolved scheduled contests are not assertions that those contests appear on the final ballot. Filter ballot_status to confirmed for confirmed contests.
This is not yet a certified exhaustive ballot dataset: unresolved cancellation/appointment questions and unverified local OCD identifiers remain.
Candidate rosters concern names printed on the ballot. Any verified write-ins are separate; write-in qualification may continue after the research date.
County arrays contain only the counties researched so far, not necessarily every county intersected by a district.
San Francisco and San Mateo were added using their official November candidate materials. Shared statewide, legislative, and judicial contests retain one record with multiple county names.
Names remain in the printed-candidate roster when a campaign has ended but the name remains on the ballot. Such cases are explained in contest notes.

The final San Francisco voter pamphlet determines resident-ballot coverage. Geographic-only intersections listed in the statewide subdivisions table do not establish an additional contest for county residents.

Contra Costa County was added by auditing all 19 municipalities, the county’s scheduled school and special-district inventory, and the federal, state and judicial ballot lists. Unopposed scheduled contests remain unverified where final on-ballot inclusion or cancellation could not be established.

The full Contra Costa August 27 final on-ballot proof PDF could not be retrieved. Its indexed header and first contest were available; other contests use linked official city/district materials, candidate statements and corroborating election coverage. The Contra Costa inventory is therefore not certified exhaustive.

Contra Costa county officers and Superior Court Position Q were resolved in June without November runoffs; no regular U.S. Senate, odd-numbered Contra Costa State Senate, or party central committee election is included for November 2026. Richmond mayor has a runoff; its June-resolved council seats are omitted.

Shared Contra Costa/Alameda contests retain their existing IDs, including CD-10, AD-14, AD-16, EBMUD Wards 3 and 7, Livermore Valley Joint Unified Trustee Area 3, and scheduled AC Transit Ward 1 and Byron-Bethany Division III. County presence does not imply countywide voter eligibility.

NPP denotes the official No Party Preference label. An omitted candidate party field in a nonpartisan contest has a different meaning. Ballot appearance and roster completeness are independent in schema version 1.3.

instructions: Use an authorized Google Civic Information API key. divisionsByAddress accepts an address and returns division IDs and aliases.
Match returned division IDs and alsoKnownAs aliases to ocd_division_id, then filter for this election and confirmed. Do not match only by county or parent jurisdiction.

For supported elections, voterInfoQuery with address and the correct electionId supplies election-specific contests. Obtain the electionId from the elections endpoint; it is not supplied in this file.

OCD IDs do not encode a boundary vintage or guarantee API coverage. Confirm 2026 boundaries, especially the congressional redistricting and newly created local districts. Missing or convention-only local IDs require additional registry/API/GIS verification before reliable automated address matching.

finance.method: FEC financial summaries for the 2026 election. Receipts include contributions, transfers, loans, offsets and other receipts as reported; they are not net donations, cash on hand, or independent outside spending. Candidate-level aggregates are used without adding committee totals again. Coverage dates are preserved exactly, including any period beginning before 2025. This is a dated research snapshot, not a live feed. Missing summary totals are null, never inferred as zero.
